widgets_values:
YESOPEN SKIT PIPELINE  ·  silnik GPU

Górny rząd: kroki na komputerze (przed GPU po lewej, po GPU po prawej). Środek: TOR GŁÓWNY, połączony liniami: still -> kwestia -> ujęcie z lip syncem -> upscale -> interpolacja. Dolny rząd: reszta GPU, też podpięta: wariant pozy (Qwen) -> ciche ujęcie LTX-2.5, rozmowa dwóch głosów, muzyka.
Jeden 'Run' robi cały pipeline GPU (kroki na komputerze, górny rząd, to opisy). Wyciszony jest tylko MiniMax H3: wymaga pisemnej zgody MiniMax; włączysz go zaznaczając jego węzły i Ctrl+M. Wskaźnik u góry mówi, czy ktoś już generuje. Wejścia (Load Image/Audio) wskazują pliki z dysku; wybierz własne. Zwinięte notatki 'Model links' rozwiń kliknięciem.
Podglądy: każdy etap kończy się węzłem Save (obraz, dźwięk, wideo), który pokazuje wynik w kanwie.

new_project.py <slug> --title '<end-card line>' -> project.json, lines.json, script.md.
Engine: gpu (default) or higgsfield.

capture-reference <link> reference/private (Ego Browser), contact_sheet.py.
Write analysis.md in your own words: mechanics only, never the reference's lines. Gate 1.

script.md + lines.json: line table, cast, START->ACTION->END->HOLD->NEXT per shot, claims table (product copy only), cost.
Nothing paid before an explicit yes to the script. gpu_batches.py estimate prints the GPU minutes.

make_edl.py -> assemble.py: scripted ffmpeg 8.x (libx264), Pillow for all text, Manrope.
cuts.json per shot, banners, captions, end card, optional music on the beat. Gate 5.

assemble.py --format 9:16 --crop-safe, crop_formats.py (4:5, 1:1), 16:9; qa_report.py --whisper.
-14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP, Whisper match about 1.0. Gate 6.

encode_variants.py: share (25 MiB), web (15 MB), poster. Links to local files first.
Then: 'Po produkcji' in script.md, reusable cast to assets/, retire the GPU (delete the machine, keep the disk). Gate 7.

Jedno miejsce na rozmiar (9:16), czas i seed. Połączone z ujęciami LTX-2.3, LTX-2.5, MiniMax H3 i upscalem.
Zmień tu, nie w etapach. Still (Z-Image) ma własny rozmiar 1088x1920 w podgrafie.

Cast stills, 1088x1920. Open the prompt with the framing: 'Vertical smartphone photo, medium shot from mid-thigh up, eye level'.
OUT: still -> pose edit, the three takes. CLI: gpu_batches.py stills -> gpu.py batch stills/batch.json (template: still). Gate 3.

Record every line twice, then fit_lines.py checks it word by word. Always set the language (Polish (pl), English (en)).
OUT: the line -> the talking take. Listen to the key lines: ASR is not voice approval. CLI: gpu_batches.py voice -> fit_lines.py.

IN: still (Z-Image) + line (Chatterbox) -> a lip-synced take, 704x1280, 24 fps. The prompt must say: framing stays the same, no zoom, no push-in.
CLI: gpu_batches.py takes -> gpu.py batch takes/batch.json (template: talk). Gate 4.
IN: the take. 704x1280 -> 1056x1920, about 63 s for a 4.4 s take. OUT: -> interpolation. CLI template: upscale.
IN: the upscaled take. 24 -> 48 fps when the motion judders. CLI template: interpolate.

IN: the still. Same person, another pose or prop; fast=true keeps face, clothes and set. Phones always show their back to the camera.
CLI: gpu.py run still-edit -s image=... -s prompt=...

Whole English conversation plus one track per speaker (SPEAKER A: ...). CLI template: tts-dialog.
AudioCrop was removed: send voice samples already trimmed.

IN: the Qwen-edited still. Silent reactions and B-roll, with room sound. Needs the gated Hugging Face licence of Lightricks/LTX-2.5.
CLI template: action (also action-t2v, action-flf).

IN: the still. Variant B: needs MiniMax's written consent (licence excludes EU, UK, US and South Korea) and a machine-generated label on publishing.
CLI template: h3-i2v / h3-talk; gpu_batches.py takes --model h3.

Instrumental bed, at least 10 s longer than the edit. music.py puts a downbeat on the cut to the end card and ducks 12 dB under every line.
CLI: gpu.py run music -s tags=... -s seconds=90 -s bpm=100.
Cześć, tu Kasia z recepcji. Zapraszam na przegląd zębów i szybką konsultację.

widgets_values_named.prompt:
Editorial tech product film. The transparent gaming mouse from <Picture 1> in its original scene: a pitch-black studio void with a dark, subtle reflective surface, lit by dramatic duotone vibrant blue and warm neon orange rim lighting, deep soft shadow falloff into pure black. Monochromatic dark palette with electric blue and amber accents. Material motif: glowing internal metallic micro-components and glossy acrylic refractions. The environment is constant throughout.
SHOT 1: The scene opens exactly on image 1, the mouse resting confidently on the dark surface; the blue and orange lights slowly pulse brighter, refracting deeply through the transparent acrylic shell as the camera executes a slow, deliberate push-in to reveal the intricate circuitry.
SHOT 2: Cut to an extreme macro profile of the ridged scroll wheel and layered internal micro-components; the camera glides slowly along the side as a sharp beam of warm orange light sweeps across the metallic textures, contrasting perfectly against the deep blue ambient glow.
SHOT 3: Cut to a low-angle beauty shot: the mouse levitates weightlessly a few centimeters above the dark reflective surface, rotating in a slow, precise orbit; the duotone lighting flares gently along the glassy transparent edges before fading slowly into a sleek silhouette.
Audio: deep pulsing sub-bass room tone, sharp tactile mechanical clicks, a sweeping glassy whoosh on cuts, and a rising electronic swell that resolves to near-silence on the final fade.

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
